title: The Rainy Night Alibi Contradiction
description:
📝 Witness Deposition:
Witness A: 'It poured rain heavily all night from 8 PM to 4 AM.'
Witness B: 'I sat in the garden at 10 PM admiring the bright full moon in a completely clear sky.'
Weather Log: Heavy downpour & storm all night.
question: Which witness is lying?
hints: Compare Witness B's clear sky claim with the official Weather Log.
Heavy rain all night makes seeing the moon in a clear sky impossible.
Witness B lied about sitting outside under a clear sky.
solution: Weather log confirms heavy rain all night. Witness B's claim of a clear full moon is a lie.
